findings.statement: Four weight files are released on Zenodo record 6463875: one phase one model and three phase two models (islets, HepG2, K562).
findings.source_says: zenodo-record.json lists ten .hdf5 files: the four TREDNet weight files plus PAS_weights_islets.hdf5, PAS_weights_HepG2.hdf5, PAS_weights_K562.hdf5, DAS_weights_islets.hdf5, DAS_weights_HepG2.hdf5 and DAS_weights_K562.hdf5, alongside annotation files such as IEP_annotation_gnomadV3_snps.bed.gz
findings.fix: Say that the record holds four TREDNet weight files (one phase one and three phase two models) alongside six smaller PAS and DAS weight files and precomputed annotation tracks, instead of implying the record contains only four weight files.

summary: Reliable. The two-phase design, the 1,924 features, the 2 kb window, the auROC figures of 0.92, 0.89 and 0.85 on enhancers from the withheld chromosomes 8 and 9, the IEP and Delta formulas in score_variant.py, the argparse defaults and required flags behind the run guide, and the conflicting licence and held-out chromosome statements all match the sources, and the page flags those conflicts itself. The one correction is that the Zenodo record holds more weight files than the page implies. No parameter count appears in any saved file.
